remedies.title: Shrink the 'store_lock' critical section: move memset, tl_spin_us outside the lock
remedies.rationale: Every MUTEX wait in a QNX trace is real contention (uncontended mutexes never enter the kernel). The lock only needs to cover statements that read or write the data it protects; computation on private buffers inside it serialises the threads for nothing.

remedies.title: Deadline misses in 'frame': a symptom
remedies.rationale: deadline miss is the visible effect; the trace also shows its cause (mutex_contention). It is expected to clear with that fix, and the re-trace checks that it does.
